enriched_invented.detail: a smooth flowing path upward rather than discrete hard jumps
the playground described as spacious and visually appealing
the chat corner treated as part of the scene's UI
screens looping video rather than playing on trigger

notes_for_us: obstacle-guess is the only row for a choice between routes and it bakes in a punishment - the wrong pick drops you. A this-or-that with no wrong answer, a vote pad, a preference split: none of them can use it without building traps, so they all fall through to free text.

A wall-mounted screen playing video has no row. landmark-focal took it because it is a large thing visible from a distance, which is true but says nothing about it being a display surface - and this prompt asks for two of them plus what plays on them.

The preset kept a mechanic the prompt's whole mood contradicts. obstacle-timing arrived with Tower Obby and had to be flagged rather than dropped; a preset carrying a difficulty flavour into a deliberately relaxing game is worth a caveat line in the genre file.
